notes.title: v1.4 - The Good Christian Boy Update
notes.notes:
HAPPY HALLOWEN, OH YE FAITHFUL

And what would Halloween be without a reason to dive back into FAITH with...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36099340/bf9b6b1d57e67ee0ebf1be354693217284ba1752.jpg
FEATURING... SURVIVAL MODE, A SPECIAL "NO DEMONS" MODE for people who have gotten the hardest achievement in the game and MORE:

[previewyoutube=HRncwTEccWA;full][/previewyoutube]
- That's right, there's a special play mode with new art and music that is available for players who have earned the 'GOOD CHRISTIAN BOY' achievement and you can now also disable demons from the Options menu. Finally a video game achievement that's as rewarding as going to church!

- SURVIVAL MODE is available after finding the good endings in Chapters I/II/III and finishing the Chapter 2 Prologue. Fight your way through a brand new environment encountering every demon we can throw at you. Finishing a Survival run earns you one of ten ranks!

- We've added FOUR new animated cutscenes. Wowza.

- There's a new unlockable background by @DragonRoIlZ

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36099340/75c6d9b89e600b626981b2e3695e66ea302d9d5c.png

- The new Survival Mode music track “Airdorf Medley” by Gavin Craum added to Soundtrack

- There's TWO new Steam achievements related to Survival mode

- And a new image added to production notebook archive in goodies. Neat.

[Fixes]

 Game window remembers the window size % when enabling/disabling full screen
 Numerous fixes for issues related to cultists that transform into hideous tentacle creatures, particularly in rooms with multiple instances of these enemies
 Fixed moments where controller rumble won’t stop rumbling (rumbling can always be canceled by pausing)
 Pausing the game while in Turbo mode returns the game to normal speed to make menu navigation easier

[Gameplay Adjustments]

 Quitting the game now takes you to the Airdorf Games splash screen instead of putting you through the “bootup”/”LOADING HYMNS” screen again
 Reduced Alu boss’ hp by 25%
 Slightly reduced hp and movement speed of the secret DUSK enemy in Garyland
 (Survival only) Gary’s RAIN OF SPIDERS attack has a ⅛ chance of reading “AUSTRALIA”
 NOTE ABOUT FAITH: DEMON SIEGE - This is a fan game made by CrackedGhostGames. Any issues/questions/complaints about the game should be directed to the developer!

Thanks for playing and remember...

GARY STILL LOVES YOU <3

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1179080/FAITH_The_Unholy_Trinity/
